'''''Koss''''' was a group of 4 [[Class-A cargo container]]s used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The containers were placed in an unknown sector of space with a small [[Mine Type A|Type A]] [[Space mine/Legends|minefield]] for protection. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Frigate]] [[Lightning (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Lightning'']] sent a single [[TIE/ca Punisher/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] to clear the minefield and inspect the containers. One of them '''Koss 4''' contained equipment while the rest contained [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. The container was boarded and the equipment taken. The containers were afterwards destroyed.
